relations.clinical_context: Acute ankle or midfoot trauma; apply Ottawa Ankle Rules before assuming simple sprain.
supporting_evidence: Ottawa Ankle Rules validated to reduce unnecessary radiographs while catching clinically relevant fractures

diagnostic_accuracy.notes: High sensitivity reported in validation literature — do not invent a specific percentage here; follow local protocol and original/rule summaries.

limitations: Not a soft-tissue sprain diagnostic tool
Intoxication, delayed presentation, and some populations need clinical judgment
recommended_examination: If rules negative → functional sprain / syndesmosis screen as indicated

Functional load progression rather than single laxity test exclusion

supporting_evidence: Plantar fasciitis CPGs emphasize load and contributing factors; proximal contributors are hypotheses not automatic causes

diagnostic_accuracy.notes: Coexistence framing — not a single-test metric.
